hero.name: Vedant Misra
hero.bio: I build products for people technology forgot. AI is racing ahead in labs; most of the world hasn't felt it yet. I care about closing that gap — why something should exist, who it's for, and whether it feels obvious to use.

reading.title: The Facebook Effect
reading.author: David Kirkpatrick
reading.note: kirkpatrick's inside account of facebook's early years: the product instincts, power shifts, and messy social consequences behind a network that changed how people relate online.
